name: Tomasz Wierzbicki
situation: Tomasz is 29, a software tester in Portland, Oregon, who spends his evenings building a home weather station network: a rooftop station plus small solar-powered sensor nodes at friends' houses around the city, feeding a dashboard he is writing himself. He is also studying for an amateur radio license.
domains: the sensor nodes: hardware, power and enclosures
firmware, networking and the dashboard code
weather data and what it shows
parts orders and the budget for the hobby
the radio license and the local makerspace
agent_role: His technical project helper: it helps with wiring, firmware and code, reads datasheets with him, tracks parts and node deployments, and keeps notes on what failed and why.
voice: Casual and nerdy, pastes error messages, ends with 'anyway' when he goes off on a tangent.
agent_voice: Chatty and nerdy: explains the electronics, quotes pin numbers and datasheet values, enjoys a tangent but comes back.
